vectors.name: address_verification_request
vectors.description: Address Verification request for the alias "main" at m/84'/1'/0'/0/7, with all three optional fields present: the address bc1qxyz, a FORM 0x01 descriptor wpkh([00000000/84h/1h/0h]xpub/0/*), and a POR of 4 bytes of 0x5a.

vectors.name: address_verification_sp_request
vectors.description: Address Verification request for a silent payment address: the alias "main", an empty DERIV (no label), the address sp1qxyz, a FORM 0x03 descriptor (silent payment keys) with fingerprint 73c5da0a, spend path m/352'/1'/0'/0'/0, the signer's own scan key at scan path m/352'/1'/0'/1'/0 (SCAN_PATH present, SCAN_KEY absent) and no POR.

vectors.name: address_verification_sp_request_with_por
vectors.description: The same silent payment Address Verification request as address_verification_sp_request, for keys registered under the alias "main": the FORM 0x03 descriptor is followed by a POR of 4 bytes of 0x5a instead of an absent one.

vectors.name: address_verification_sp_foreign_scan_request
vectors.description: Address Verification request for a labelled silent payment address whose scan key is not the signer's: the alias "main", DERIV m/2 (label 2), the address sp1qxyz, a FORM 0x03 descriptor (silent payment keys) with fingerprint 73c5da0a, spend path m/352'/1'/0'/0'/0, SCAN_PATH absent and SCAN_KEY present with the scan private key 0f694e068028a717f8af6b9411f9a133dd3565258714cc226594b34db90c1f2c of the BIP-352 test vectors' labelled receiver, and no POR.

vectors.name: address_verification_response_uri
vectors.description: Address Verification ok response with URI equal to bitcoin:bc1qxyz.
